Who I Am

About Me

I am Bayzid Islam Taj, a passionate Computer Science & Engineering student at Northern University of Bangladesh, maintaining a strong CGPA of 3.60. I am simultaneously pursuing a BBA in Philosophy at Dhaka College, reflecting my drive to grow across multiple disciplines.

Beyond academics, I bring a creative edge — from graphic design and video editing to event management. My IELTS band of 6.5 demonstrates strong English communication skills, enabling me to work effectively in professional international environments.

I am goal-driven, detail-oriented, and always eager to take on new challenges that allow me to grow both personally and professionally.
